### Starlink: Regulatory timeline {.use-case-slide background-image="assets/starry_sky.png"}


FCC Authorization History (see [@axis2026starlink])

| Date      |    Authorization      |    Cumulative Approved |
|:----------------:|:----------------------:|:----------------------:|
| 2018      |    Initial 4,425 satellite approval      |    4,425 |
